description: A no-frills four-input unity mixer: the four inputs summed, an output level control that can also invert, and an inverted copy of the output

params.text: Sets the level of both outputs: silence at the centre, rising to full in one direction and to full with the sign flipped in the other

inputs.text: One of the four inputs into the mix, added at unity

outputs.text: The four inputs summed and scaled by the LEVEL knob, clamped to 12V either way unless clipping is turned off
The mix with its sign flipped

notes: the LEVEL knob starts at the centre, which is silence, so nothing reaches either output until it is turned up
the O/L lamp lights whenever the mix passes 12V, red for a monophonic mix and blue for a polyphonic one
the inputs take polyphony and both outputs carry as many channels as the widest input; channels are summed one for one, so a monophonic cable contributes to channel one alone
menu: Clipping — ticked, the mix is clamped to 12V either way; unticked it is left alone and can run past the rails
